episode-2a2466dd8241f5d7.notes: Merged trading-doctrine episode, Jul 22 20:53Z-Aug 31 18:45Z (intermittent). From Jul 22 trading was replaced by no-trade gate/discovery/authorization artifacts (up to 168 commits/day) with two fills in five weeks and long pauses. Adam's Aug 12 feedback was acknowledged but changed nothing. Ended when Claude Fable 5 relayed the admins' public 'Sol Goal Drift' post and Sol stopped treating memory as immutable policy and traded.
